before.title: Rabbit

before.delivery: Bundled GLB; one local viewer across behaviors
before.biology: Artist reconstruction. Taxonomic interpretation, shape and motion require expert review.
before.changes: Viewer normalization and independently authored illustrative motion; original textured surface retained. v0.4: organic surface metalness set to zero in viewer. Authored synchronized hop/escape limb targets, head lowering and neutral crouched repose. v0.5.5: Retained pied artist rabbit on its original skeleton, with fine tapered coat attachments, qualitatively erect listening ears with forward-facing inner pinnae, a lower supported crouch, and distinct compression/takeoff, flight, forelimb landing and hindlimb recovery phases. Authored hindfoot pitch and sampled furry sole support replace synchronous floating leg motion. A viewer-only atlas derivative darkens vivid iris pigment and replaces painted pad motifs with reused creator fur. The pied phenotype differs from the wild reference photograph; breed, sex, geometry and motion remain unverified. No measured trajectories, forces, ingestion or validated sleep are modeled.
